notes:
Account summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (customer support/product help desks). Building an agent that routes to tools (CRM search, ticket creation).
- Primary evaluation track: Hosted API for fast time-to-value, then Dedicated if throughput and data isolation justify commit.
- Latency SLOs: target median streaming first-token <200ms (NA), tail (<95th) <500ms; end-to-end user-perceived reply within ~1s for short answers.
- Throughput targets: ~600-900 concurrent chat sessions peak, average 150k tokens/day expected after rollout. Cost sensitivity: moderate — will trade some cost for latency but need predictable unit economics.
- Security: Must support SSO via Okta, audit logging for agent actions, KMS for key management, EU data residency for EU users.
- Routing/fallback: regional routing required (NA -> us region, EU -> eu region); fallback policy must avoid cross-border processing for EU user data (GDPR constraint). Want automatic fallback to lower-cost model variant only within same region and with audit trail.
- Product asks: streaming + tool-calling latency demos, ability to trace token-level cost, model variant switch + canary rollout support, per-route dashboards.

Call notes / quotes:
- CTO (Maya Singh): "If our assistant stalls >0.5s for interactive ops we see churn in usability — latency is non-negotiable."
- Head of Product (Samir Rao): "We want hosted first to move fast; Dedicated if we can lock latency and cost predictability."

Procurement / commercial:
- Wants a banded price for 6 months of Dedicated reserved capacity if POC meets SLOs. Evaluating pricing vs. current provider; procurement window end of Dec.

Technical wishlist for POC:
- NA + EU endpoints, streaming SDK wired into web client, tool-calling demo (ticket create + CRM search), Redwood Console demo with token-level cost + per-route latency charts, automatic region-aware fallback demo.
